name: gr_self_compl_connected
statement: (V : Type) [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : Nonempty (SimpleGraph.Iso G Gᶜ)) : G.Connected
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : Nonempty (SimpleGraph.Iso G Gᶜ)), G.Connected
informal: A self-complementary graph is connected — by contradiction: if G is not connected then Uses Mathlib2.comb_compl_connected_of_not_connected at step 1 to get Gᶜ connected, and transport connectedness back along the isomorphism (SimpleGraph.Iso.connected_iff), contradiction.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Nonempty (G ≃g Gᶜ) → G.Connected
